answer: Continuous physical-presence attestation. Each agent identity must ship a tamper-evident sensor log, co-signed by a distinct fixed beacon at a hollow warehouse site, proving its operator occupied that site continuously for 30 days before activation. Beacons are hardwired to a mesa-mounted clock and cannot be cloned across sites. An attacker must staff and power one real physical location per identity, so the per-identity cost is rent, power, and 30 days of labor — not a token harbor.
